sources.description: Explore a financed house purchase with ownership expenses and additional payments.
sources.purpose: Monthly mortgage cost and repayment schedule.
sources.formulaVerification: The full competitor calculation model was not verified. Existing P&I is independently verified in the project: M=P*r/(1-(1+r)^(-n)); M=P/n at zero rate.
sources.observedCurrency: $; US mortgage context; no currency switch verified
sources.historicalFinding: The core financed-payment calculation and schedule exist. Integrated ownership expenses and recurring extra-payment combinations are not exposed in these tools. Extend existing loan tools rather than add another basic EMI implementation.

sources.description: Solve a percentage amount, a part-to-total rate, an inverse base, or an adjusted amount.

observedModes: starting amount, percentage and increase/decrease selector

formula: adjusted = start * (1 + rate/100) or start * (1 - rate/100)
sources.purpose: Four percentage calculation modes visible in retained controls and mathematical notation.

sources.historicalFinding: Percentage-of and related ratio/change operations exist on separate pages. The percentage page itself does not expose all four observed modes. Prefer extending it and retaining existing canonical slugs.
